blocks.text: Langley real estate market stats for October 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Langley?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 445 houses listed in Langley and 59 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 13%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Langley?
faq.a: The October report gave $1,300,000 for houses in Langley, against $1,345,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Langley?
faq.a: The October report showed 21 days on market for houses in Langley and a sale-to-list price ratio of 98%, against 20 days the month before.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Langley?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Langley?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
